title: Tables masu tsabta, tsarin aiki da sigogi na gaskiya
course_title: Karatun Bayanai: Fayil ɗin Jarida, Charts da Ma'aunin Kasuwanci

say: Tables masu tsabta, tsarin aiki da sigogi na gaskiya.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo na module 2 na Ilimin Bayanai.
Yawancin matsalolin maƙunsar bayanai suna farawa da shimfidawa, ba tsari ba. Idan an tsara teburin da kyau, kowane lissafin yana ɗaukar daƙiƙa.

say: Kowace dabara tana farawa da alamar daidai. Misali, Chioma na sayar da kayan abinci a babbar kasuwar Onitsha. Garri: guga 6 akan naira 2,500. Tsarinta, C4 sau D4, yana ba da 15,000.
Ta kwafi dabarar ƙasa ginshiƙi, kuma kowane jere yana daidaitawa da kanta.

say: Wata na iya samun ɗaruruwan layuka. Babu wanda yake ganin tsari ta gungurawa. SUMIF yana ƙara layuka ne kawai waɗanda suka dace da sharadi, kamar kalmar Shinkafa.

card.title: Ina kudin Ada suke zuwa?
card.note: Jimlar ta abu ta amfani da SUMIF.

say: Ada yana lissafin kowane abu kuma yana amfani da SUMIF kusa da shi. Shinkafa ta kawo naira 180,000. Wato 180,000 aka raba ta 400,000, sau 100, wanda shine 45%.

card.title: Ina kudin Ada suke zuwa?
card.note: Jimlar ta abu ta amfani da SUMIF.

say: Kayayyakinta sun kai 400,000, daidai da SUM na kowane kuɗi, hannun jarinta ya ƙara zuwa 100%. Koyaushe gudanar da wannan rajistan. Idan bai dace ba, wasu layuka ana rubuta su daban.
Shinkafa kusan rabin tallace-tallacenta ne, don haka ta ajiye aƙalla buhu biyu a hannunta.

say: Karanta kowane ginshiƙi daga waje a cikin tallace-tallace 70 na iya nufin kwalabe 70 ko Naira 70,000, don haka duba raka'a. A kan ginshiƙi na mashaya, ƙimar ƙimar yakamata ta fara a sifili, in ba haka ba ƙananan bambance-bambance suna da girma.
Sannan nuna ginshiƙi ga mutum ɗaya. Idan ba za ta iya bayyana saƙon a cikin jumla ɗaya ba, inganta shi.

say: Don tunawa. A gyara teburin ku. Bari dabaru suyi aikin. Takaita ta rukuni kuma koyaushe bincika yana ƙarawa. Kuma zaɓi ginshiƙi na gaskiya tare da bayyanannen take da raka'a.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Jeri ɗaya a kowace rikodi, shafi ɗaya a kowace maɓalli
Formula farawa da = kuma sabunta kansu

Jimlar rukuni dole ne ya dace da jimillar SUM
Bars suna kwatanta, layi suna nuna lokaci, pies suna ƙarami

say: Juyin ku. Gina log ɗin ku, taƙaita shi, kuma ku yi ginshiƙi wani zai iya fahimta a cikin jumla ɗaya.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
